policies.text: An air provider receives lead status if it possesses executive clearance and maintains guaranteed liability coverage of at least $25,000,000.
A travel vendor receives transit clearance when operating a motorcoach fleet size of 15 buses or greater.
An air supplier secures executive clearance by maintaining premier status.
Regional cargo priority is assigned to freight companies that record a yearly lost shipment percentage below 1.0 percent.
A carrier achieves premier status if it maintains an active fleet size of at least 10 aircraft, holds ARGUS Platinum certification, and keeps an annual flight delay rate of 5.0 percent or lower.
Maritime passenger endorsement is granted to any vessel operator maintaining a fleet of at least 5 cruise ships and holding Solas Safety Certification.
